# kion_ou_cloud_access_role_exemption (Resource)

Manages a Kion OU Cloud Access Role Exemption.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_ou_cloud_access_role_exemption" "example" {
  # Optional
  # ou_cloud_access_role_id = 1
  # ou_id                   = 1
  # reason                  = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ou_cloud_access_role_id` (Number) ID of the ou cloud access role in the application being exempted from.
- `ou_id` (Number) ID of the ou in the application.
- `reason` (String) Reason the Cloud Access Role is being exempted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the record in the application.
